description: REST-MNETA-MDD 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：站点协变量校正；rest-mneta-mdd 表型/刺激提取；rest-mneta-mdd 质控汇总；rest-mneta-mdd 数据校验；fMRIPrep 本地环境执行；混杂回归与去趋势；ROI 时间序列与功能连接；任务态一级 GLM；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: 站点协变量校正
method_refs.role: Run the original harmonization dispatcher in fixed site-covar mode on a subject-by-feature NPY matrix and row-aligned metadata containing batch and protected covariates. Retain harmonized features, metadata, site-effect reports and a manifest. Use the original implementation and its declared statistical assumptions。 Inputs: features: NPY 特征矩阵 (file); meta: 样本协变量 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/harmonized_features.npy, results/manifest.json. Fixed invocation options: --method site-covar.

method_refs.label: rest-mneta-mdd 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge REST-meta-MDD phenotype data. Reads REST-meta-MDD phenotype files (diagnosis, clinical measures, site info) and produces a merged phenotype table aligned with imaging subject list。 Inputs: phenotype_files: 文件路径清单（每行一项） (file); imaging_ids: imaging-ids (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: rest-mneta-mdd 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries for REST-meta-MDD processing. Multi-site QC: tracks site effects and applies site-appropriate thresholds。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: rest-mneta-mdd 数据校验
method_refs.role: Validate REST-meta-MDD BIDS structure and generate compliance report. Checks directory structure, site identification, and diagnostic group labeling。 Inputs: input: input (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: fMRIPrep 本地环境执行
method_refs.default_reason: 配置 LOCALFLOW_FMRIPREP_EXECUTABLE 后可直接运行，不向后端开放 Docker socket。
